rationale: The core technical premise of the short entry has failed, as price did not stall at the 5-minute 9-EMA ($187.66) and instead broke decisively above it to $188.36 on expanding 1-minute volume (39.9k to 58.6k shares). With the thesis invalidated by price action and the bid/ask approaching the $188.60 hard stop, closing immediately preserves capital and remaining daily loss budget. A flip to long is not warranted given the heavily negative earnings catalyst, wide 10.6 bps spread, and overhead resistance below session VWAP ($192.67).
